details: During the Developer Update on May 2, 2024 it was announced that VRChat is going to implement SteamVR 2.0 Input. As nice as it's great that we have skeletal input support and now official documentation on the skeletal input drivers for SteamVR as of yesterday from the time this is posted (source: https://creators.vrchat.com/platforms/pc/steamvr-drivers/) it would be nice to have any official confirmation on being allowed to rebind gesture override functions. As it stands from reading the update things like holding world props or grabbing things in VRChat will be made available via SteamVR 2.0 inputs, which is a big improvement for those that do not have Vive Wands, but besides this for index users they have to manually pose their fingers to do gesture overrides, which can be really annoying at times and was the reason why VRChat put a gesture lock button in the game. If VRChat is allowing people to bind gestures to specific toggles in game, then they should also allow gesture overrides to be rebindable as well
title: Open access to Gesture Overrides in SteamVR 2.0 Bindings
